data.title: git log --oneline -10; echo "---"; git status --short | Select-Object -First 30
Get-ChildItem -Force | Select-Object Mode,Name | Format-Table -AutoSize
Get-Content package.json; echo "=== TSCONFIG ==="; Get-Content tsconfig.json

Write-Output "=== BACKEND ==="; Get-ChildItem backend -Recurse -File -Exclude *.log | ForEach-Object { "{0,8}  {1}" -f $_.Length, $_.FullName.Replace("$PWD\","") }; Write-Output ""; Write-Output "=== GOOPSPEC ==="; Get-ChildItem .goopspec -Recurse -File | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName.Replace("$PWD\","") }
Write-Output "=== SRC TREE ==="; Get-ChildItem src -Recurse -File | ForEach-Object { "{0,8}  {1}" -f $_.Length, $_.FullName.Replace("$PWD\","") } | Sort-Object

Write-Output "=== README ==="; Get-Content README.md; Write-Output ""; Write-Output "=== GOOPSPEC STATE ==="; Get-Content .goopspec\state.json; Write-Output ""; Write-Output "=== HISTORY ==="; Get-Content .goopspec\history\2026-10-02.json

Write-Output "=== GITIGNORE ==="; Get-Content .gitignore; Write-Output ""; Write-Output "=== DOCKERIGNORE ==="; Get-Content .dockerignore; Write-Output ""; Write-Output "=== DIRSIZES (excl node_modules) ==="; Get-ChildItem -Directory -Force | Where-Object { $_.Name -notin @('node_modules','.git') } | ForEach-Object { $s = (Get-ChildItem $_.FullName -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum); "{0,-18} {1,6} files {2,10:N0} KB" -f $_.Name, $s.Count, ($s.Sum/1KB) }
Write-Output "=== server.ts lines: $((Get-Content server.ts).Count) ==="; Get-Content server.ts

Write-Output "=== BRANDING / HARDCODED SEARCH ==="; Select-String -Path src\*.tsx,src\**\*.tsx,src\*.ts,index.html,server.ts -Pattern "ReBot|TeleOffer|teleoffer|rebot|Lunoxy|lunoxy" -SimpleMatch:$false | Select-Object -First 60 | ForEach-Object { "{0}:{1}: {2}" -f $_.Filename, $_.LineNumber, $_.Line.Trim().Substring(0,[Math]::Min(120,$_.Line.Trim().Length)) }

Write-Output "=== LOC ==="; Get-ChildItem src,backend -Recurse -File -Include *.ts,*.tsx,*.css | ForEach-Object { "{0,6}  {1}" -f (Get-Content $_.FullName).Count, $_.FullName.Replace("$PWD\","") } | Sort-Object -Descending; Write-Output ""; "{0,6}  server.ts" -f (Get-Content server.ts).Count; "{0,6}  index.css" -f (Get-Content src\index.css).Count

Write-Output "=== TODO/FIXME/HACK ==="; Select-String -Path src\*.tsx,src\**\*.tsx,backend\**\*.ts,server.ts -Pattern "TODO|FIXME|HACK|XXX:|@ts-ignore|@ts-expect-error|any\b" | Group-Object { $_.Filename } | Sort-Object Count -Descending | Select-Object -First 15 | ForEach-Object { "{0,4}  {1}" -f $_.Count, $_.Name }; Write-Output ""; Write-Output "=== console.log count ==="; (Select-String -Path src\**\*.tsx,src\*.tsx -Pattern "console\.log" ).Count
Write-Output "=== AUTH ROUTES ==="; Get-Content backend\routes\authRoutes.ts | Select-Object -First 60; Write-Output ""; Write-Output "=== STORAGE CONFIG ==="; Get-Content backend\config\storage.ts

Write-Output "=== ENV KEYS (names only) ==="; Get-Content .env | ForEach-Object { if ($_ -match '^\s*([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s*=') { $matches[1] } }; Write-Output ""; Write-Output "=== HARDCODED SECRET-LIKE PATTERNS ==="; Select-String -Path server.ts,backend\**\*.ts,src\**\*.tsx -Pattern "(password|secret|apikey|api_key|token)\s*[:=]\s*['\"][^'\"]{6,}" -CaseSensitive:$false | Select-Object -First 25 | ForEach-Object { "{0}:{1}: {2}" -f $_.Filename, $_.LineNumber, $_.Line.Trim() }

Write-Output "=== LOGIN / AUTH GUARD search ==="; Select-String -Path src\*.tsx,src\**\*.tsx,server.ts,backend\**\*.ts -Pattern "auth|login|password|session|token" -CaseSensitive:$false | Group-Object { $_.Filename } | Sort-Object Count -Descending | Select-Object -First 10 | ForEach-Object { "{0,4}  {1}" -f $_.Count, $_.Name }; Write-Output ""; Write-Output "=== App.tsx routes ==="; Select-String -Path src\App.tsx -Pattern "Route|path=|element=|Navigate" | ForEach-Object { "{0,5}: {1}" -f $_.LineNumber, $_.Line.Trim() }

Write-Output "=== .env size ==="; (Get-Item .env).Length; Write-Output "=== .env (masked) ==="; Get-Content .env | ForEach-Object { if ($_ -match '^([A-Za-z0-9_]+)=(.*)$') { "$($matches[1])=<len:$($matches[2].Length)>" } else { $_ } }; Write-Output ""; Write-Output "=== index.html ==="; Get-Content index.html; Write-Output ""; Write-Output "=== vite.config ==="; Get-Content vite.config.ts
src\App.tsx

Write-Output "=== backup-folder ==="; Get-ChildItem backup-folder -Recurse -File | Select-Object -First 15 | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName.Replace("$PWD\","") }; Write-Output ""; Write-Output "=== scratch ==="; Get-ChildItem scratch -Recurse -File | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName.Replace("$PWD\","") }; Write-Output ""; Write-Output "=== fix-history ==="; Get-ChildItem fix-history -Recurse -File | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName.Replace("$PWD\","") }; Write-Output ""; Write-Output "=== data ==="; Get-ChildItem data -Recurse -File | ForEach-Object { "{0,8}  {1}" -f $_.Length, $_.Name }

Write-Output "=== accounts.json (masked) ==="; $j = Get-Content data\accounts.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $j | ForEach-Object { "accountId=$($_.accountId) phone=$($_.phone) apiId=$($_.apiId) apiHash=<len:$($_.apiHash.Length)> session=<len:$($_.sessionString.Length)>" }; Write-Output ""; Write-Output "=== DASHBOARD PASSWORD mechanism ==="; Select-String -Path src\components\LoginPage.tsx,server.ts -Pattern "DASHBOARD_|PASS|password" -CaseSensitive:$false | Select-Object -First 20 | ForEach-Object { "{0}:{1}: {2}" -f $_.Filename, $_.LineNumber, $_.Line.Trim().Substring(0,[Math]::Min(110,$_.Line.Trim().Length)) }

Write-Output "=== CSS theme tokens ==="; Select-String -Path src\index.css -Pattern "^\s*(\[data-theme|:root|@theme)" | ForEach-Object { "{0,5}: {1}" -f $_.LineNumber, $_.Line.Trim() }; Write-Output ""; Write-Output "=== CSS var count ==="; (Select-String -Path src\index.css -Pattern "--[a-z-]+:" ).Count; Write-Output ""; Write-Output "=== TEST FILES ==="; Get-ChildItem -Recurse -File -Include *.test.ts,*.test.tsx,*.spec.ts,*.spec.tsx -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch 'node_modules' } | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName.Replace("$PWD\","") }; Write-Output "(none above = no tests)"; Write-Output ""; Write-Output "=== lint run ==="; npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 20

Write-Output "=== any global middleware / cors / helmet ==="; Select-String -Path server.ts -Pattern "cors|helmet|express.json|app.use\(|rateLimit|middleware" | Select-Object -First 25 | ForEach-Object { "{0,5}: {1}" -f $_.LineNumber, $_.Line.Trim() }; Write-Output ""; Write-Output "=== server.ts imports ==="; Get-Content server.ts | Select-Object -First 45

Write-Output "=== tracked sensitive files? ==="; git ls-files | Select-String -Pattern "accounts.json|\.env$|ai_config|stats.json|data/" | ForEach-Object { $_.Line }; Write-Output "--- (above = tracked)"; Write-Output ""; Write-Output "=== git tracked total ==="; (git ls-files).Count; Write-Output ""; Write-Output "=== LoginPage auth logic ==="; Get-Content src\components\LoginPage.tsx | Select-Object -First 40

Write-Output "=== hardcoded Indonesian UI strings (rough count) ==="; (Select-String -Path src\**\*.tsx,src\*.tsx -Pattern '"[A-Z][a-z]+ [a-z]+' | Where-Object { $_.Line -match '[a-z]\s+[a-z]+' }).Count; Write-Output ""; Write-Output "=== App.tsx tail (page render) ==="; Get-Content src\App.tsx | Select-Object -Skip 440 -First 130

Write-Output "=== tracked file ==="; git ls-files; Write-Output ""; Write-Output "=== is data/ ignored? ==="; git check-ignore -v data/accounts.json .env 2>&1; Write-Output ""; Write-Output "=== mojibake (replacement char) count per file ==="; Get-ChildItem src,backend -Recurse -File -Include *.ts,*.tsx,*.css | ForEach-Object { $c = (Select-String -Path $_.FullName -Pattern "\uFFFD" -AllMatches).Matches.Count; if ($c -gt 0) { "{0,5}  {1}" -f $c, $_.FullName.Replace("$PWD\","") } }; $c = (Select-String -Path server.ts -Pattern "\uFFFD" -AllMatches).Matches.Count; "{0,5}  server.ts" -f $c
Write-Output "=== Dockerfile ==="; Get-Content Dockerfile; Write-Output ""; Write-Output "=== capacitor ==="; Get-Content capacitor.config.ts

Write-Output "=== data/ ignored? ==="; git check-ignore -v data/accounts.json; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { "NOT IGNORED -> akan ikut ter-commit" }; Write-Output ""; Write-Output "=== media/ ignored? ==="; git check-ignore -v media/; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { "NOT IGNORED" }; Write-Output ""; Write-Output "=== backup-folder/ backups/ ignored? ==="; git check-ignore -v backup-folder/data/accounts.json backups/ 2>&1; Write-Output ""; Write-Output "=== untracked file count ==="; (git status --porcelain).Count
Write-Output "=== confirm untracked top-level ==="; git status --porcelain; Write-Output ""; Write-Output "=== node/npm version ==="; node -v; npm -v
REFACTOR-PLAN.md

Write-Output "=== size ==="; (Get-Item REFACTOR-PLAN.md).Length; Write-Output ""; Write-Output "=== CJK/Hangul contamination ==="; Select-String -Path REFACTOR-PLAN.md -Pattern '[\u4e00-\u9fff\uac00-\ud7af]' | ForEach-Object { "L$($_.LineNumber): $($_.Line.Trim())" }

$p = 'REFACTOR-PLAN.md'
$lines = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]](Get-Content $p -Encoding UTF8)
$fix = @{}
$fix[129] = '### 3.3 Sebaran Brand (Brand Scatter) - 9 titik'
$fix[199] = '# contoh: data/accounts.json -> .gitignore:<line>:data/'
$fix[373] = '- `"private": true` + tambahkan `"license": "UNLICENSED"` bila lisensi proprietary, atau `"SEE LICENSE IN LICENSE.md"` bila Anda memilih GPL'
$fix[427] = 'Produk ini disediakan "as is" - tanpa garansi. Lakukan pengujian sendiri sebelum dipakai produksi.'
$fix[428] = '> Jangan klaim produk ini sudah diuji atau terverifikasi terhadap kebijakan Telegram - pembeli yang bertanggung jawab atas penggunaan masing-masing.'
$fix[461] = 'Semua brand terpusat. Ini yang membuat produk bisa dijual ke orang berbeda tanpa menyunting 9 file.'
$fix[519] = '- **Opsi A (minimal, cukup untuk penjual):** biarkan apa adanya. Warnanya sudah token-based (`var(--accent)`), dan `App.tsx` sudah mendukung 5 tema + picker. Pembeli bisa ganti warna dengan edit 20 baris CSS.'
$fix[522] = '> Rekomendasi: **kerjakan Opsi A dulu** (cepat, risiko rendah, pembeli sudah bisa ganti brand). Opsi B hanya bila ada waktu luang. Yang wajib dari Opsi B hanya: pastikan **tidak ada hex color inline di JSX**. Cek `grep -rn "#[0-9a-fA-F]\{6\}" src/ --include=*.tsx` - hasil ideal hanya di `PinkAestheticBg.tsx` dan props chart library.'
$fix[544] = '## FASE 4 - Refactor Monolith (ZERO KEHILANGAN FUNGSI)'
$fix[558] = '**4.0.1 - Nyalakan type strict, tapi siapkan dulu**'
$fix[566] = '> **CARA AMAN menyalakan `strict`:** bakal muncul banyak error (terutama implicit-any di file besar). Plan yang benar: **fix `server.ts` & `backend/` DULU** (bagian 4.1), baru nyalakan `strict` di commit terpisah. Menyalakan `strict` di awal = badai error yang menutupi masalah asli.'
$fix[592] = '| 9 | `server.ts` -> **target akhir < 250 LOC** | Hanya: import, DI, wiring semua router, auto-start | - |'
$fix[594] = '> **Peringatan khusus `BotCore` (#4) dan `MessageQueue` (#5):** keduanya adalah inti bot dan paling rawan. Ekstrak dengan **copy-paste dengan gangguan minimal**: pindahkan kode apa adanya, ubah hanya `import`/`export`, pertahankan nama variabel lokal persis. Jangan "sambil merapikan".'
$fix[733] = '> Kalau diterjemahkan, pembeli non-Indonesia tidak bisa diagnose error Telegram - dan itu justru use case utama dashboard ini.'
$fix[812] = '| 3 | Sengaja break satu test | Test gagal -> gating bekerja |'
$fix[871] = '- [ ] Contoh config.json (tanpa data asli)'
foreach ($k in $fix.Keys) { $lines[$k-1] = $fix[$k] }
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllLines((Resolve-Path $p), $lines, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false))
Write-Output "patched $($fix.Count) lines"

$p='REFACTOR-PLAN.md'
Write-Output "=== CJK/Hangul remaining ==="
$r = Select-String -Path $p -Pattern '[\u4e00-\u9fff\uac00-\ud7af\ufffd]'
if ($r) { $r | ForEach-Object { "L$($_.LineNumber): $($_.Line.Trim())" } } else { Write-Output "CLEAN" }
Write-Output ""
Write-Output "=== suspicious '?' runs / stray tokens ==="
$r2 = Select-String -Path $p -Pattern '\?\?|<=|\bmo\]|Teh|\(dan\b'
if ($r2) { $r2 | ForEach-Object { "L$($_.LineNumber): $($_.Line.Trim())" } } else { Write-Output "CLEAN" }

$p='REFACTOR-PLAN.md'
$lines=[System.Collections.Generic.List[string]](Get-Content $p -Encoding UTF8)
$lines[666]='> `activePage` di `App.tsx:88-98` memakai nested ternary. Rapikan jadi object map `{ "/logs": "logs", ... }[pathname] ?? "dash"` - lebih mudah dibaca, output identik.'
$lines[706]='**Estimasi:** 3 jam | **Risiko:** sedang | **Nilai:** bergantung pada target pembeli'
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllLines((Resolve-Path $p),$lines,(New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false))
Write-Output "patched L667, L707"
Write-Output ""
Write-Output "=== residual non-ASCII (should only be em-dash/arrow/emoji) ==="
$t = Get-Content $p -Raw -Encoding UTF8
[regex]::Matches($t,'[^\x00-\x7F]') | ForEach-Object { $_.Value } | Group-Object | Sort-Object Count -Descending | ForEach-Object { "{0,4}x  {1}" -f $_.Count, $_.Name }

$p='REFACTOR-PLAN.md'
$t=[System.IO.File]::ReadAllText((Resolve-Path $p))
$rep=@(
 @('| `index.html:8` | `theme-color="#0a0a0b"`','| `index.html:7` | `theme-color="#0a0a0b"`'),
 @('`server.ts:20-45`','`server.ts:21-45`'),
 @('`server.ts:~250-360`','`server.ts:296-362`'),
 @('`server.ts:~500`','`server.ts:367`'),
 @('`src/index.css:8-110`','`src/index.css:8-107`'),
 @('`index.css:8-110`','`index.css:8-107`'),
 @('`backend/routes/authRoutes.ts:14-27`','`backend/routes/authRoutes.ts:17-31`'),
 @('`server.ts:~250-360`)','`server.ts:296-362`)')
)
$n=0
foreach($r in $rep){ if($t.Contains($r[0])){ $t=$t.Replace($r[0],$r[1]); $n++ } else { Write-Output "NOT FOUND: $($r[0])" } }
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText((Resolve-Path $p),$t,(New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false))
Write-Output "applied $n/$($rep.Count) replacements"
Select-String -Path REFACTOR-PLAN.md -Pattern '250-360|8-110|tele-auth' | ForEach-Object { "L$($_.LineNumber): $($_.Line.Trim())" }

$p='REFACTOR-PLAN.md'
$t=[System.IO.File]::ReadAllText((Resolve-Path $p))
$rep=@(
 @('5 blok tema hardcoded di baris **8-110**','5 blok tema hardcoded di baris **8-107**'),
 @('Temat diterapkan via','Tema diterapkan via'),
 @('Seluruh `/api/*` terbuka untuk siapa pun. remotely add akun, kirim pesan, baca semua data.','Seluruh `/api/*` terbuka untuk siapa pun: bisa menambah akun, mengirim pesan, dan membaca semua data.'),
 @('Server **tidak pernah** memeriksa flag ini. consequence:','Server **tidak pernah** memeriksa flag ini. Konsekuensinya:'),
 @('localStorage key `tele-auth` (`App.tsx:74-75`).','localStorage key `tele-auth` (`App.tsx:74-75` untuk cek, `App.tsx:312-313` untuk logout).')
)
$n=0
foreach($r in $rep){ if($t.Contains($r[0])){ $t=$t.Replace($r[0],$r[1]); $n++ } else { Write-Output "NOT FOUND: $($r[0].Substring(0,[Math]::Min(45,$r[0].Length)))" } }
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText((Resolve-Path $p),$t,(New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false))
Write-Output "applied $n/$($rep.Count)"
Select-String -Path REFACTOR-PLAN.md -Pattern 'banget|\bbad\b|\bdone\b' | ForEach-Object { "L$($_.LineNumber): $($_.Line.Trim().Substring(0,[Math]::Min(120,$_.Line.Trim().Length)))" }

Write-Output "=== headings ==="
Select-String -Path REFACTOR-PLAN.md -Pattern '^#{1,2} ' | ForEach-Object { "L$($_.LineNumber)  $($_.Line)" }
Write-Output "`n=== stats ==="
$c = Get-Content REFACTOR-PLAN.md
"lines   : $($c.Count)"
"bytes   : $((Get-Item REFACTOR-PLAN.md).Length)"
"fences  : $((Select-String -Path REFACTOR-PLAN.md -Pattern '^```').Count)  (harus genap)"
"tables  : $((Select-String -Path REFACTOR-PLAN.md -Pattern '^\|').Count)"
Select-String -Path REFACTOR-PLAN.md -Pattern '^## .*FASE' | ForEach-Object { "L$($_.LineNumber)  $($_.Line)" }
